headline: Recommended staggering school start times near the new Pawtucket High School because of expected traffic.
summary: The group heard updates on construction, traffic and parking, and snow storage for the new Pawtucket High School. It recommended staggering start times and raised concerns about student parking. Discussion of a concept for the Amvet property was left for the next meeting.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 10, 2026 meeting, with all members voting yea.
Recommended staggering start times for the schools near the new Pawtucket High School because of expected heavy traffic.

decision_evidence.quote: A. September 10, 2026 Motion: Matthew Wildenhain Second: Terrance Mercer Yea: all Motion carries.
It has been recommended that start times get staggered as there are 3 levels of school in a very close proximity that will lead to heavy traffic.

decision_titles: Staggered start times for schools near new Pawtucket High School
